title: Strategy-Proof Set-Valued Choice on Single-Dipped Domains
abstract: arXiv:2609.14059v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study strategy-proof social choice where agents have single-dipped preferences and outcomes may be sets of alternatives. While point-valued strategy-proof rules select an endpoint, we ask which outcomes survive when sets are compared through responsive extensions. Under the standard responsive extension, preferences over fixed-length intervals remain single-dipped, so the endpoint restriction persists and anonymity yields a single-threshold rule. Under responsive dominance, the incomplete order shared by all responsive extensions, an interior interval can survive because the two extreme intervals need not be comparable. For arbitrary sets, requiring every chosen alternative to be most preferred by some agent yields voting-by-committees rules, with one committee per endpoint; anonymous rules have a two-threshold quota form. The characterization holds on the entire endpoint-peaked domain, and every such rule is group-strategy-proof.

translated_title: 单谷域上的策略防操纵集值选择
translated_abstract: 我们研究代理人具有单谷偏好、结果可能为备选方案集合的策略防操纵社会选择问题。虽然点值策略防操纵规则会选择一个端点，我们探究当集合通过响应性扩展进行比较时，哪些结果能够存留。在标准响应性扩展下，固定长度区间上的偏好仍保持单谷性，因此端点限制依然成立，且匿名性导出单阈值规则。在响应性占优（即所有响应性扩展共享的不完全序）下，内部区间可以存留，因为两个极端区间之间未必可比。对于任意集合，要求每个被选中的备选方案都是某个代理人的最偏好结果，将导出委员会投票规则，每个端点对应一个委员会；匿名规则具有双阈值配额形式。该刻画在整个端点峰域上均成立，且所有此类规则都是群体策略防操纵的。
tldr: 本文刻画了单谷偏好下集值策略防操纵选择规则：在标准响应性扩展下端点限制依然存在并导出单阈值规则，在响应性占优下内部区间可存留，而对任意集合则得到委员会投票规则（匿名形式为双阈值配额规则），且所有此类规则均为群体策略防操纵的。
